notes.title: Game Guru V1.11 Released
notes.content:
[h1]What’s new in GameGuru V1.11?[/h1]
Today we’re happy to announce V1.11 of GameGuru!

[b]Level Editor[/b]
[list]
[*] New toolbar option which allows the selections of markers only
[*] Markers can now be single selected, even if clipping mode is active
[*] Adjusted widget system so X, Y, Z, XYZ scaling is axis aligned to entity orientation
[*] Added new EDITORS\KEYMAP folder with ability to remap any key used by GameGuru
[*] Sped up entity zoom in mode
[*] Spray mode now has a range, similar to the dynamic lights.
[*] Added a modifier to all entity properties to control when LOD kicks in
[*] Current editing mode is now displayed in window title area
[*] Using return with clip mode finds the floor rather than the roof
[*] Fixed PGUP and DOWN respects the size of the selected entity when in snap mode
[*] Adjusted free flight mode to not break the sound barrier!
[*] Fixed a slowdown in the IDE 
[*] The D/L button in the Store Downloader is not ghosted out when updating the list
[*] Character Creator now reports head limbs being shot and has been added to light ray render
[*] Fixed an issue with Character Creator heads 
[*] Fixed an undo issue with regards to raising terrain with characters on, then undoing
[*] Fixed an issue where an entity would turn to wireframe when still above the ground
[*] Fixed an issue with SKYSPEC file settings
[*] Fixed an issue where the property panel would stay open if a video was selected whilst in properties
[*] Fixed a problem with resetting weapons
[*] Fixed an issue with using the widget and R key to rotate
[/list]
[i]Editor/Importer[/i]
[list]
[*] Waypoints are no longer shown in the importer
[*] Importer collision tab drag handles now work
[*] Removed objectives from the importer options as they are never used
[/list]
[b]Games & Models[/b]
[list]
[*] New Gem World game added
[*] Media from Gem World added to the Cartoon category for you to use.
[/list]
[img]http://content.game-guru.com/V1_11/gem.jpg[/img]

[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list]
[*] Head-shot feature added
[*] Added back spot flashes for player and enemies shooting
[*] Picking up an enemy weapon now yields more than one bullet
[/list]
[b]Rendering[/b]
We’ve made some subtle and important changes to the rendering engine.
[list]
[*] Ambience does not contribute to shadows on highest entity settings
[*] Fixed enemy fire decals not displayed in the correct order
[*] The Occluder no longer causes shadows of occluded objects to being rendered
[*] Fixed an issue where fairly large objects would be distance occluded far too soon
[*] Fixed an issue with the occluder where certain objects would flicker
[/list]
[b]Stand-alone[/b]
We’ve improved the save stand-alone system to ensure all files are exported properly.

[b]Lua Scripting[/b]
The scripting commands have been expanded significantly. We’ve added new sprite commands which are ideal for creating your own HUDs. 
[list]
[*] LoadImage: myImage = LoadImage ( "myFolder\\myImage.png" ) -- Anywhere inside GG Files folder (however it is best to put into scriptbank images folder for making standalones)
[*] CreateSprite: mySprite = CreateSprite ( myImage ) – creates a sprite using image #myImage
[*] DeleteSprite: DeleteSprite ( mySprite ) – deletes a sprite
[*] SetSpritePosition: SetSpritePosition ( mySprite , x , y ) – sets the position of a sprite at the % based x,y pos
[*] SetSpriteSize: SetSpriteSize ( mySprite , sizeX , sizeZ ) – sets the size of a sprite. Passing -1 as one of the params ensure aspect ratio retained
[*] SetSpriteDepth: SetSpriteDepth ( mySprite , depth ) –sets the ordering of a sprite, 0 is front, 100 back
[*] SetSpriteColor: SetSpriteColor ( mySprite , red , green, blue, alpha ) – adds a coloured tint to a sprite
[*] SetSpriteAngle: SetSpriteAngle ( mySprite , angle ) – Sets the angle of a sprite. Default angle is zero
[*] SetSpriteOffset: SetSpriteOffset ( mySprite , xoff , yoff ) – Sets where the handle is for the sprite.
[*] SetSpriteImage: SetSpriteImage ( mySprite , myImage ) – change the image assigned to a sprite.
[*] GetFirstEntitySpawn() GetNextEntitySpawn() useful for scripts that need to deal with entities that can come into existence at any time (both return 0 if no new entity)
[*] GetDeviceWidth() and GetDeviceHeight() return the width & height of the device.
[*] SetFogIntensity(v) – sets the fog intensity.
[*] SetFont ( "FontName" , 1) To change in game font. Font 1-3 are defaults.
[*] SetPlayerWeapons(0) – A value of 0 disables player weapons, 1 restores them
[*] SetAttachmentVisible(e,1). 1 sets the entities attachment to be visible (such as their weapon), 0 switches it off
[*] SetFlashLight(1), 1 switches the flashlight on, 0 off
[*] SetFlashLightKeyEnabled(1) - 1 for on, 0 for off. Disables the flashlight key from being used
[*] SetOcclusion(100), control the occluder setting - from 0 (off) to 100 (max). 10 & under for minimal popping
[/list]
[i]Fixes and changes to existing Lua commands[/i]
[list]
[*] If SetAnimationSpeed(speed) has a speed value over 100, it is divided by 100. So 100 becomes 1.
[*] UnFreezePlayer() no longer has the fade in effect or resets anything in the game
[*] SetSound(e,v) to be used before functions such as SetSoundVolume(vol) which do not specify a sound to use
[*] Added new keyboard, mouse and entityinzone LUA commands and scripts
[*] Fixed the LUA dynamic music load command
[*] Fixed a LUA bug where GetInkey()
[*] SetAnimationSpeed now accepts a negative number
[*] Fixed Dynamic music system (new scripts included)
[*] Error messages no longer go behind the window 
[*] Loading an image no longer causes a runtime error, instead it silently fails and writes to the default log file
[/list]
[b]Radar[/b]
[list]
[*] Updated Radar script to use new commands
[*] Radar and objective scripts, plus media can be found in scriptbank\radar
[*] Added the new Radar to The Big Escape, Morning Mountain Stroll and Get To The River maps.
[/list]
[img]http://content.game-guru.com/V1_11/radar.jpg[/img]
[b]Performance[/b]
[list]
[*] Shadows+Occluder are sped up to previous fast speed, but retrain the non popping of nearby objects
[*] Fixed the occluder to handle spinning round fast
[/list]
[b]F9 Mode[/b]
[list]
[*] When in F9 mode, going into entity (e) mode no longer causes a slow down
[*] Fixed an issue with F9 mode where sometimes characters would not animate
[/list]

[b]Misc[/b]
[list]
[*] DBO self-delete now detects down to the minute so any change in minutes upwards triggers a refresh
[*] Fixed rocket enemy killing themselves after respawning
[*] Fixed a memory leak relating to keyboard input
[*] Fixed a crash that could occur in multiplayer 
[/list]
[b]Light mapping[/b]
The light mapper has had some subtle improvements too.
[list]
[*] Added light mapping settings in SETUP.INI for higher quality shadows
[*] Smoothing angle added to light mapper settings and setup.ini
[*] Fixed light map darkness issues
[*] Fixed an issue that ignored certain objects scaling
[*] Shadow intensities now match when comparing real time to prebake
[/list]

We hope you enjoy this interim build. Watch our [url=http://www.twitch.tv/gamegurulee]weekly Twitches here[/url] and catch up on [url=https://www.game-guru.com/live-streams]past sessions here.[/url]

[*] SetAttachmentVisible(e,1). 1 sets the entities attachment to be visible (such as their weapon), 0 switches it off
[*] SetFlashLight(1), 1 switches the flashlight on, 0 off
[*] SetFlashLightKeyEnabled(1) - 1 for on, 0 for off. Disables the flashlight key from being used
[*] SetOcclusion(100), control the occluder setting - from 0 (off) to 100 (max). 10 & under for minimal popping
[/list]
[i]Fixes and changes to existing Lua commands[/i]
[list]
[*] If SetAnimationSpeed(speed) has a speed value over 100, it is divided by 100. So 100 becomes 1.
[*] UnFreezePlayer() no longer has the fade in effect or resets anything in the game
[*] SetSound(e,v) to be used before functions such as SetSoundVolume(vol) which do not specify a sound to use
[*] Added new keyboard, mouse and entityinzone LUA commands and scripts
[*] Fixed the LUA dynamic music load command
[*] Fixed a LUA bug where GetInkey()
[*] SetAnimationSpeed now accepts a negative number
[*] Fixed Dynamic music system (new scripts included)
[*] Error messages no longer go behind the window 
[*] Loading an image no longer causes a runtime error, instead it silently fails and writes to the default log file
[/list]
[b]Radar[/b]
[list]
[*] Updated Radar script to use new commands
[*] Radar and objective scripts, plus media can be found in scriptbank\radar
[*] Added the new Radar to The Big Escape, Morning Mountain Stroll and Get To The River maps.
[/list]
[img]http://content.game-guru.com/V1_11/radar.jpg[/img]
[b]Performance[/b]
[list]
[*] Shadows+Occluder are sped up to previous fast speed, but retrain the non popping of nearby objects
[*] Fixed the occluder to handle spinning round fast
[/list]
[b]F9 Mode[/b]
[list]
[*] When in F9 mode, going into entity (e) mode no longer causes a slow down
[*] Fixed an issue with F9 mode where sometimes characters would not animate
[/list]

[b]Misc[/b]
[list]
[*] DBO self-delete now detects down to the minute so any change in minutes upwards triggers a refresh
[*] Fixed rocket enemy killing themselves after respawning
[*] Fixed a memory leak relating to keyboard input
[*] Fixed a crash that could occur in multiplayer 
[/list]
[b]Light mapping[/b]
The light mapper has had some subtle improvements too.
[list]
[*] Added light mapping settings in SETUP.INI for higher quality shadows
[*] Smoothing angle added to light mapper settings and setup.ini
[*] Fixed light map darkness issues
[*] Fixed an issue that ignored certain objects scaling
[*] Shadow intensities now match when comparing real time to prebake
[/list]

We hope you enjoy this interim build. Watch our [url=http://www.twitch.tv/gamegurulee]weekly Twitches here[/url] and catch up on [url=https://www.game-guru.com/live-streams]past sessions here.[/url]

notes.title: GameGuru Performance Release V1.1
notes.content:
Today we're releasing the brand new GameGuru performance build. We have converted the original engine to a C++ foundation and highly optimised the game loop for improve frame rate performance.

There’s more help for new users with the aid of a new getting started guide and a range of video tutorials that step them through all the aspects of the software and easy access to the archive of Twitch videos that the development team blog every week.

[img]http://content.game-guru.com/V1_1/videoscreen.jpg[/img]

Our CEO and lead developer Lee Bamber has this to say about this build [i]"This update is the most significant release since the launch of GameGuru and introduces an incredible boost in performance for most users.  In addition to increased frame rates, you can expect a number of long-requested feature improvements, such as entity group selection in the editor and an improved help system"[/i]

[b]Performance Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Converted the whole GameGuru engine from DarkBasicPro source code to C++
[*] Optimised the C++ source code;
- Speed increase on real-time shadows and grass
- LUA Speed increase 
- Sound Speed increase
- Spawned entities
[/list]
[*] Developed the Occluder further
[img]http://content.game-guru.com/V1_1/occlusion.jpg[/img]
- Occluder runs on a separate thread and creates optimum draw calls for rendering each frame
- Entities that make bad occluders are marked in the fpe (lots of fpes updated)
[/list]
[b]Editor[/b]
One of the key new features added to the editor is the new rubber band selector. You can now drag and group select many entities and the move, rotate, scale and delete them.

[img]http://content.game-guru.com/V1_1/rubberband.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*] New rubber band control lets you highlight multiple entities. 
[*] When spraying characters, X and Z angles are no longer adjusted
[*] Fixed visual settings getting wiped after a reloaded session
[*] Pressing space key now deselects any entity current selected
[*] Objects are now easier to scale when they are already a large size
[*] Green resource bar is now reset between levels
[*] When you exit GG and choose to save on exit, the level no longer reloads after saving
[*] Fixed an issue where an entity that was a clone would not de-highlight and remain green
[*] Fixed the RECENT folder not showing up on some machines
[*] EDIT ALL in the IDE is now called CLIP OFF to be clearer
[/list]


[b]Test Game[/b]
[list]
[*] numpad + and - now work in F9 mode
[*] You can now use TAB from the last F11 FPS Screen
[*] Performance boost if DOF and Motion Blur are set to 0!
[*] Dynamic resolution: If the draw count is high and fps is below 60, the resolution will dynamically adjust to improve frame rate
[*] Characters use a diff shader from a distance and do not animate, even when instances
[*] Shadows speed up: Shadows are not always drawn for objects dependant on their distance and size
[*] When in test game the mouse no longer affects the game if GG does not have the focus
[/list]

[b]Sound[/b]
[*] Changed zombie sounds to mono so they can be used as 3d sounds
[*] Fixed ogg files memory leak
[/list]
[b]LUA[/b]
[*] Fixed SetSoundSpeed in LUA
[*] Fixed all LUA shader related commands to not freeze animations when called (changing DOF, Vignette etc)
[/list]
[b]Standalone[/b]
[*] Fixed crash issue after playing multiple levels in standalone
[*] Fixed an issue with games that used their own custom images not having them when building in standalone
[/list]
[b]Model Importer[/b]
[*] Fixed importer from not naming normal and specular files
[/list]
[b]Weapons[/b]
[*] Fixed Uzi V mode issue which locked damage to 30 regardless of settings
[/list]
[b]Lightmapping[/b]
[*] Fixed an issue where some buildings disappeared when lightmapped
[/list]
[b]Misc[/b]
[*] LOD specified in the FPE now works
[*] You can now shoot the winged fantasy creature thanks to a new FPE field
[*] Dynamic resolution can now be switched off via setup.ini with disabledynamicres=1
[*] Fixed several issues with fantasy characters
[*] Demo games now have a start and complete screens
[/list]

notes.title: Weekly News: Performance work moves forward!
notes.content:
[img]http://content.game-guru.com/news/gglogo.jpg[/img]
Welcome to another GameGuru news update. We've got a little more to report this week. Progress has been good and while we're still not able to give you any eye watering screenshots we are happy with the way things are moving forward.

You can read all the details below as well as catching up on what else is new in the world of GameGuru.

[img]http://content.game-guru.com/news/2015/100815/ggnews1.jpg[/img]

Our regular glance at the galleries has uncovered this gem by GDNomad. It’s great to see users covering different genres and creating such impressive screenshots. [i]In other news…[/i]

[h1]Store News[/h1]

Another great week for the store with more than 5,400 entities, sounds, music and scripts now available for download with many more being uploaded and approved daily.

[img]http://content.game-guru.com/news/2015/100815/ggnews2.jpg[/img]

This excellent [url=https://en.tgcstore.net/pack/10647]Alleyways Pack[/url] from [url=https://en.tgcstore.net/artist/27308]KenCharlesLong[/url] is ideal for almost any modern day game. Designed with background use in mind, the screenshot above shows the pack in action along with some default assets as well as a couple of items from MegaPack 3.

[img]http://content.game-guru.com/news/2015/100815/ggnews3.jpg[/img]

Also on the buildings front is this [url=https://en.tgcstore.net/pack/10646]new blocks pack[/url] from [url=https://en.tgcstore.net/artist/45257]Oldpman[/url] combines some new entities from the artist as well as some of his older work to make a very useful pack with a modern day feel.

[h1]Become a Store Artist![/h1]

The Game Creator Store connects creative artists and musicians with enthusiastic GameGuru game developers. Can you create game ready 3D models or themed atmospheric music for the GameGuru community? If so, sign into the GameGuru website and [url=https://en.tgcstore.net/sell-content]sign up to HERE![/url]

[h1]Keep Voting[/h1]

The votes are still coming in for which feature you all want to see us work on after the performance work. If you want to see something new added to GameGuru this is the best way of getting your voice heard, and if you've not already done so or you want to change your mind, now is the time to vote

So we can be sure we’re developing the features that matter the most to our community your opinion is important.

When voting, don't forget:
[list]
[*] Features voted towards the “Urgent” right side will score higher marks.
[*] The more features you mark as “Really need” and “Urgent”, the less these scores will be worth.
[*] It’s therefore best to choose just a few items that are important to you and score those highly.
[*] The scoring is live and you can change your votes at any time.
[*] Your changes are updated immediately so no need to save.
[/list]
[url=https://www.game-guru.com/feature-vote]Cast your Votes HERE[/url]

The progressive save and load system is still way in lead with AI navigation improvements following close behind. There have been some small changes further down the voting list, but it seems clear so far what you’d like us to work on next.

[h1]GameGuru update[/h1]

The core performance work is now well underway and after a couple of weeks of hard work, the development team are almost ready to activate a niffy little tool of their own devising that will instantly convert the core DBP language on which GameGuru was originally based into super fast C++.In addition to this, we have now eliminated the need for separate DLL’s, offering us not only a significant performance boost, but creating a more stable platform for future additions.This of course doesn't mean we've finished with the optimizations and performance improvements as we've still got a fair way to go, but this is good news for you as we will soon have a very solid and fast core engine on which to base all of our future work, eventually speeding up releases in the long term and allowing us to improve the engine at a faster rate.
Signing Off

Firstly, a big thank you to all of our loyal users for bearing with us during this time, we're sure you won't be disappointed when we have something to show you.

Don't forget [url=https://www.game-guru.com/devblog/]Lee’s Blog[/url] for daily updates on development and of course the occasional Twitch Stream. You can keep up to date with all development news virtually as it happens, and I'm sure some small teasers on a few other things.

[i]The GameGuru team[/i]

notes.title: Friday Devblog - Performance Week
notes.content:
It's been a fragmented week for coding, but with two of us on the case we've covered a surprising amount of ground in re-working the engine ready for the core restructuring work and optimizations. We are currently at what you would call the foundation layer to test the very basics of the rendering and CPU profiles, and with a single logo and some text we are clocking over 7000 frames per second which is a little extreme.

In other news, our character artist continues to create new content for future releases, which this week saw the creation of our Barbarian character. The great news is that we have prepared him as character creator parts so you can mix and match when you get hold of this model.  We will also create a few pre-created Barbarians so you can also just drop one in and go.

[img]http://content.game-guru.com/devblog/24JUL15-helmtexture.JPG[/img]

We also found time to test the most recent release, and found a little time to experiment with high specular and lighting in this cool moon base shot below:

[img]http://content.game-guru.com/devblog/24JUL15-Spaceoutpost.png[/img]

Work continues next week on performance as we move from foundation work and onto the actual core loops. We are hoping to see gains almost right away, and from that increased start we can begin optimizing via profilers and some n-core technology.  It won't be seven thousand frames per second, but we should see a mark improvement in game speed over the next few weeks plus a much cleaner project area for us, which means faster bug fixes and quicker feature implementations!

In other news, our character artist continues to create new content for future releases, which this week saw the creation of our Barbarian character. The great news is that we have prepared him as character creator parts so you can mix and match when you get hold of this model.  We will also create a few pre-created Barbarians so you can also just drop one in and go.

[img]http://content.game-guru.com/devblog/24JUL15-helmtexture.JPG[/img]

We also found time to test the most recent release, and found a little time to experiment with high specular and lighting in this cool moon base shot below:

[img]http://content.game-guru.com/devblog/24JUL15-Spaceoutpost.png[/img]

Work continues next week on performance as we move from foundation work and onto the actual core loops. We are hoping to see gains almost right away, and from that increased start we can begin optimizing via profilers and some n-core technology.  It won't be seven thousand frames per second, but we should see a mark improvement in game speed over the next few weeks plus a much cleaner project area for us, which means faster bug fixes and quicker feature implementations!

notes.title: Make your vote count!
notes.content:
[img]http://content.game-guru.com/news/gglogo.jpg[/img]
Another week looms into view and we're very pleased to welcome thousands of new users to the world of GameGuru from the recent Humble Bundle promotion. If you're new to GameGuru, this is where you can catch up with all of the latest news, views and updates from our Store, our community and of course our hard working development team.

[h1]GameGuru update[/h1]
As our regular followers will be aware, hot on the trail of our recent updates comes the start of the performance work. It is still very early days so there’s nothing to report in the way of statistics, figures or eye candy, but even at this stage, with many wires hanging out, we're very happy to say that work is well underway.

As the team work diligently to squeeze lots of extra FPS  out of the engine, we're already looking to the future of development, and are pushing ahead with our promise that GameGuru is and will remain to be a community lead project. A major part of this is the new voting system. A fair, balanced and easy to use online survey, asking you to tell us what you want to see after the performance work.

[h1]Vote Now[/h1]
We are always listening to our users and the one thing we heard loudest was you all shouting. “Let us tell you what we want next.”

So, we've listened and introduced this new voting system.

We want your feedback so we can be sure we're developing the features that matter the most to our community,  please read this guide before you start voting please note;

Features voted towards the “Urgent” right side will score higher marks.
The more features you mark as “Really need” and “Urgent”, the less these scores will be worth.
It’s therefore best to choose just a few items that are important to you and score those highly.
The scoring is live and you can change your votes at any time.
Your changes are updated immediately so no need to save.
[url=https://www.game-guru.com/feature-vote]Cast your Votes HERE[/url]

[h1]Store News[/h1]
This week we’re taking a look back at two of the great modern weapons packs from long standing store artist [url=https://en.tgcstore.net/artist/124126]BSP[/url].  These excellent packs expand the range of weapons by 20 between them, and are a must for any serious game developer.

[img]http://content.game-guru.com/news/2015/210715/ggnews1.jpg[/img]

[url=https://en.tgcstore.net/pack/10373]Modern Weapons Pack 1[/url]

[img]http://content.game-guru.com/news/2015/210715/ggnews2.jpg[/img]

[url=https://en.tgcstore.net/pack/10411]Modern Weapons Pack 2[/url]

Don’t forget to check out the [url=https://en.tgcstore.net/]Store[/url] for all of the latest releases and of course 1000’s of free and paid models to help bring your games to life.

[h1]Become a Store Artist![/h1]
The Game Creator Store connects creative artists and musicians with enthusiastic GameGuru game developers. Can you create game ready 3D models or themed atmospheric music for the GameGuru community? If so, sign into the GameGuru website and [url=https://en.tgcstore.net/sell-content]sign up to HERE![/url]

[h1]More Twitching![/h1]
We're sure you've all been keeping up with Lee’s Twitch’s. (Support very well by our own Dave “Ravey” Milton. If not, you can keep up with the regular broadcasts [url=http://www.twitch.tv/gamegurulee]here.[/url]

As we keep reminding you, we strive to be very much community lead, and on top of our voting system, we'd also like to know what you would like us to Twitch about.

Click [url=https://forum.game-guru.com/thread/212794]here[/url] to see a list of our recent broadcasts, and also for a chance to help shape future Twitch’s.
https://youtu.be/hbYNDhzBfG0


[h1]Don't forget our competition![/h1]
There’s still plenty of time to get in on the latest competition and grab yourselves some free store points to spend on some of the great GameGuru media available from our store. As a reminder, this time, we’re asking you to come up with the most imaginative custom face using the new Character Creator import a face feature and we’ll be awarding the best FIVE entries 3,000 store points each.

There’s no restrictions on what kind of face you make but we’ll be judging on originality, quality and entertainment. To enter, all you need to do is create your face, upload it to the gallery and send us the link and a copy of the character. (Located in the custom Character Creator folder). Best of luck to everyone and we’re looking forward to seeing what our talented users can come up with.

[i]The Rules[/i]

1) You may only use public domain or custom images, you may be required to prove usage rights.
2) Please email the image link and the custom character to Dave Hawkins at davehawkins@thegamecreators.com

Ensure you use the format USER – FORUM -COMPETITION8 e.g thescenecommander-GameGuru- competition8 in the subject line. Entries that do not meet this criteria will be disqualified.

3) You must include the following information in your email.
3.1) Your real name
3.2) A valid email for your TGC account so we can award prizes.
4) All entries must be received by midnight GMT 31st July 2015.
5) This competition is not open to any member of TheGameCreators staff or support team.
6) You may enter as many times as you like, but remember quality is better than quantity.
7) The competition will be judged by at least two members of TheGameCreators staff and their decision will be final.

[h1]Signing Off[/h1]

That’s it for this week. Don’t forget [url=https://www.game-guru.com/devblog/]Lee’s Blog[/url] for daily updates on development and of course the thrice weekly Twitch Streams, where you can keep up to date and  maybe get a couple of teasers.

As always, thanks for your incredible support and we'll speak to you all again next week.

[i]The GameGuru team[/i]

notes.title: GameGuru Weekly News - 13th July 2015
notes.content:
Welcome to another week here in the GameGuru caves. We've seen a huge number of users join the GameGuru club in the last week thanks to [url=https://www.humblebundle.com/]Humble Bundle.[/url] This of course has in turn led to lots of new questions and the diligent support team at GameGuru HQ have been pleased and keen to help.

Part of this has been an expansion in our help system, so you can now chat live with a member of the team almost 24/7. Of course, if we are out, you can simply leave a message and someone will contact you as soon as possible.  All you need to do to get advice is click on the Green Chat button on the main [url=https://www.game-guru.com/]GameGuru website[/url] at the bottom right of the web page.

As you know, we're always keeping an eye out for great screenshots and this one from GameGuru user GDNomad really impressed us with it's clever use of the sliders to create a great atmosphere.

[img]http://content.game-guru.com/news/2015/130715/ggnews1.jpg[/img]

Ok, now let's see what's been going on in the world of GameGuru.

[h1]Store news[/h1]
It was only last week we reported hitting the 5,000 milestone for store items available on the [url=https://en.tgcstore.net/]GameGuru Store[/url] and now we can report we've already exceeded 5,100 with that number growing daily.

https://youtu.be/9b5Toz0A9hM

Popular and talented artist [url=https://en.tgcstore.net/artist/123361]Dagored[/url] has continued to impress with his critters range by adding these excellent [url=https://en.tgcstore.net/product/23795]Elks.[/url] Ideal for almost all genres and available for a bargain price it's a model no serious developer can do without.

[img]http://content.game-guru.com/news/2015/130715/ggnews2.jpg[/img]
Also new this week is the [url=https://en.tgcstore.net/pack/10627]great tree pack[/url] from regular artist [url=https://en.tgcstore.net/artist/124126]BSP.[/url] Featuring a total of 41 trees of many different types, including a selection with a covering of snow, why not head on over to the store and grab yourself some more vegetation.

[h1]Become a Store Artist![/h1]
The Game Creator Store connects creative artists and musicians with enthusiastic GameGuru game developers. Can you create game ready 3D models or themed atmospheric music for the GameGuru community? If so, sign into the GameGuru website and [url=https://en.tgcstore.net/sell-content]sign up to HERE![/url]

[h1]Join us on TWITCH![/h1]
As many of you are aware we've recently started a regular series of TWITCH broadcasts aimed at guiding users new and old through some of the finer points of GameGuru. We plan on broadcasting this week on Monday, Wednesday and Friday, so why not join in the fun and maybe learn something new about GameGuru?

You can view all of the tutorials from the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/266310/guides/]Steam guides[/url] as well as finding lots of other great gems of information. For those of you who don't know about these TWITCH broadcast you can see what it's all about in the video below.

https://youtu.be/l_GwdAIrgDw

Our esteemed coder Dave "Ravey" Milton takes the reigns from Lee Bamber and will be covering the Character Creator, Multiplayer Games and then the Multiplayer script in detail. Lee is taking a busman's holiday this week by attending Develop Brighton. GameGuru has been shortlisted in the [url=http://www.developawards.com/award/]Develop Awards[/url] so we send our best wishes to Lee for Wednesday night!

[h1]GameGuru latest[/h1]
Hot on the heels of V1.003 we've released two fast and furious updates to GameGuru in the last week fixing a minor issue and improving the help system.

[i]V1.01.0032[/i]
* Added link to our Twitch channel in the help menu
* Fixed an issue in the editor where Character Creator heads could disappear after test game

[i]V1.01.0031[/i]
* Removed 'loading range' report from debug log as redundant

For the weeks ahead our focus is all on improving GameGuru's performance, so we ask for your patience as this will take a little while, meaning a small lull in updates, but we're extremely confident that you will love the results.

[h1]Signing off[/h1]
Don't forget Lee’s Blog for daily updates on development and maybe a couple of performance teasers.

As always, thanks for your amazing support and we'll speak to you all again next week.

[i]The GameGuru team[/i]

notes.title: Friday Live Broadcasting
notes.content:
Another good broadcast and hopefully informative one, which can now be seen in catch-up on the GameGuruLee page now. You can also catch earlier broadcasts from the same page, and for older broadcasts you can find them exported to the GameGuru YouTube channel.

[img]http://content.game-guru.com/devblog/GameGuruLee-videoplaceholder.png[/img]
http://www.twitch.tv/gamegurulee/

The performance work has gone well this week, and we are now facing quite a lot of line by line donkey work before we can start to see things running again. As I will be enjoying myself at Develop Brighton next week the task falls to my tireless side-kick Ravey to start the process, and knowing him, probably finishing the process before I get back.  Stage one is simply to convert the core engine to pure C++ while retaining 100% functionality of build 003, and once we achieve this we should see an immediate boost in speed. From there we proceed to stage two which will involve splitting the optimization work between us based on some profiling analysis and our own gut feel of what needs immediate attention.

If you are lucky enough to be attending the Develop Brighton conference, you can attend my speaker session during the Evolve Day (Tuesday 14th July) in Room 4 with the title ‘User Generated Content – Next Generation’ here: http://www.developconference.com/Content/Evolve-2015

With my broadcast duties completed, and a need for tea, I find myself wandering what to do next. I am leaning towards playing a few Steam games (a rare thing for me) and relaxing a little as this week has been pretty packed. Until my next blog (which might be as long as 10 days now) have a great weekend and I hope you enjoy the broadcasts idea and do let me know if you want to see more of this.

We're checking out the latest feedback from the GameGuru and Steam forums and we will be fixing a couple of things based on your responses before moving onto the long awaited task of optimisations. In fact we released a small update today that fixed an issue for standalone games. We're looking forward to the performance work ahead of us and we're sure you'll be please with the results when we release V1.004!

We’ve also listened to your feedback and made a number of improvements to the store front end which we hope will make the store even easier to use for all of you. The new site design launched on Friday last week and we’ll be making a number of improvements as we move forward.

[img]http://content.game-guru.com/news/2015/070715/ggnews2.jpg[/img]

This week we’d like to remind you all about this excellent [url=https://en.tgcstore.net/pack/10375]SciFi walls pack[/url] by [url=https://en.tgcstore.net/artist/39010]Wizard Of Id[/url] – Featuring a selection of walls ideal for a futuristic city or fortress.

[img]http://content.game-guru.com/news/2015/070715/ggnews3.jpg[/img]

Another great pack that you might have forgotten about are these static [url=https://en.tgcstore.net/pack/10432]scifi gun turrets[/url] by [url=https://en.tgcstore.net/artist/134272]JForthDesigns[/url]. Ideal for adding atmosphere to any game based in the future and available in six variations.

[i]The GameGuru team[/i]

notes.title: Friday Devblog - Version 1.01.003 RELEASED
notes.content:
The title says it all, and after many weeks and many many tweaks we have a release for you, in the shape of a sizable update to Game Guru. We kept new features to a minimum this time, which mainly consists of a new way to map any face onto the custom characters created in the Character Creator module. Whether it be your own face for your multiplayer avatar or the faces of your enemies in a first or third person romp you have more tools at your disposal to create a unique and interesting game.

[img]http://content.game-guru.com/devblog/build101003b-NiceGFX.png[/img]

In the update, you will also find subtle improvements to the third person system so enemies are a little more aggressive, able to attack from a greater range.

[img]http://content.game-guru.com/devblog/build101003b-SeriouslyCrazyTesting.png[/img]

If you so wish you can create some seriously crazy visuals if your game style demands it, though in my own test above I probably got carried away a little.

[img]http://content.game-guru.com/devblog/build101003b-LargeLevel.png[/img]

In another walk through test, I suddenly turned around at the end of the level and realized just how much game there actually is in The Big Escape, one of the sample levels you can find in the latest version.

Some other interesting changes have happened such as the temporary removal of the Interactive Tutorial mode in favor of additional menu items to link videos, tutorial pages, demo games and more help links on the IDE which we feel is less intrusive that a huge splash when GameGuru starts.

Perhaps the biggest news is that starting next week my 'speed team' consisting of myself and Ravey 'the raven' Dave will begin the work of increasing the performance of the product, and the number one requested feature from the community in the last few weeks.  Despite working on performance about a year ago, we neglected the low to mid range systems which had better than average graphics cards and multiple cores, and users want to use their PCs to maximum effect (of course). To that end we will be breaking down GameGuru into its component parts and analyzing each area for possible speed gains, from the individual game loop instructions right the way through the scene graph, physics and the AI system. We will also be adding multiple core threads to the engine to run several processes in parallel to the main game thread when more than one core is detected. All these small gains will accumulate into a sizable increase in your frame rate and hopefully turn a level that struggles to get to 30 fps into something that does not drop below 60 fps.  No small achievement, which is why for this project we have banned deadlines, with a single simple goal to get ALL stock levels running at over 60 fps on our mid-range test system.

We have recently released the GameGuru news about the update and also the main TGC newsletter as well, so if you want to read more just visit the main site or even catch-up on the daily antics of a developer by checking out my blog here: https://www.game-guru.com/devblog/?p=241

Until next week, have a great weekend, make many many games and as always please let us know what you think of the latest update and get your feature requests ready for the arrival of the new voting system when we will see what you'll be getting next after performance!

notes.title: V1.003 Released!
notes.content:
Today we're releasing GameGuru V1.003, it's packed with new updates and some exciting new features.

[h1]Add your own face to characters![/h1]
This new feature lets you import an image file and then map a face from that image onto a 3D head. The resulting character can be an enemy in single player mode or you can play as that character in multiplayer mode! Here's Rick our Development Director suited up in his armour suit.
[img]http://content.game-guru.com/news/v1003/rick_knight.jpg[/img]
We're sure you'll enjoy this new feature and we can't wait to see you in a Multiplayer game soon!

[h1]Many, many tweaks & fixes![/h1]
This build has focused on lots of little issues. Here's the full run down of changes;
[h1]Editor[/h1]
[list]
[*] Replaced CHECKING FOR FILES with full status progress text (catch any issues)
[*] Moved version number display to start of splash sequence (saved 1.5 seconds)
[*] Fixed all marker entities so they no longer Z clash with terrain & floors
[*] Increased speed of APPLY CHANGES in Entity Properties (activemouse detection)
[*] Fixed issue which ignored ROT values when spraying entities with 'I' key
[*] Re-activated code which XZ rotates entities slightly in spray mode
[*] F1 Help Page now stays on screen when F1 key held down
[*] Changed CLIP mode (TAB then CTRL+MouseWheel) to be independent of zoom
[*] Added new RECENT folder to PURCHASED folder to list all store items
[*] Fixed RECENT view in PURCHASED folder to sort by CREATION date
[*] Store Downloader now tries to resume a file when the connection has dropped rather than start over
[*] Prevented accidental rotation when switch to terrain mode via toolbar
[*] Will now exit splash windows if select FILE MENU items at Getting Started
[*] Resume From Previous Session now works again after IDE front dialog changes
[*] Removed INTERACTIVE TUTORIAL MODE in favour of existing VIDEO TUTORIAL LINKS
[*] Added new DEMO GAMES and MORE MEDIA menus for additional help for new users
[*] Fixed issue causing Save Standalone to fail if mouse in 3D area when clicked
[/list]
[h1]Test Level[/h1]
[list]
[*] Removed redundant , and . keys in game as visual adjusted with sliders now
[*] If no water exposed in terrain, test game will skip water mask generation
[*] Can no longer drag TAB TAB slider panels until 'click' on the panel header
[*] Can now scroll contents of large drop down lists by moving mouse outside of box area
[/list]
[h1]Engine[/h1]
[list]
[*] Now allows entities as static, even if animates (except character_basic.fx)
[*] Moved hardwareflags reset to game init routine, terrain visibility reset
[*] Created shader instance for TPV characters for zero-depth rendering
[*] Created shader instance for TPV entity for zero-depth rendering
[*] Removed clipping cap and ensured Y position value is accurate
[*] Fixed a rare crash in shadow mapping
[*] Changed post process shader passes to all use Shader Model 3.0 (driver friendly)
[*] Fixed issue with POST PROCESS shader using fixed DOF render size (now adapts)
[*] When collect JETPACK and in TPV, FPV HUD is now hidden from view
[/list]
[h1]Character AI[/h1]
[list]
[*] When character turns to instance in distance, uses correct idle (not 3000-3100)
[*] Also assign correct anim speed to instances at distance
[*] Prevent any animations on distant objects where CPUANIM flag is set in FPE
[*] If character has no .DAT file associated (UBER), no longer rotates the waste
[*] Adjusted non DAT characters (above) to accurately line up gun direction
[*] Prevented character AI from using ANIMSPEED of zero, reverts to 100 by default
[*] Custom character heads now stay attached even at extreme out of range distances
[/list]
[h1]Fantasy Pack DLC Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added new WIZARD EVIL and WIZARD ROYAL to the character assets
[img]http://content.game-guru.com/news/v1003/evilwizard.jpg[/img]
[*] Added new STAFF icon and ammo icon (and new HUD mode of 11 to gunspec)
[*] Ensured all Fantasy Creatures do not 'repeat-hit' and only hit once
[*] Ensured Fantasy Creatures can hurt at double range to make combat tougher
[*] Updated TAURUS characters in Fantasy DLC to proper scale (super large)
[*] Fixed ORC and REPTILIAN character feet heights (for Fantasy Pack DLC)
[/list]
[h1]Death Valley Pack DLC Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*] New buildings added
[*] Big selection of rocks, cliffs, arches and pillars added
[*] Addition scenery items
[/list]
[h1]Weapons[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue of shotgun loading two shells when only one remained
[*] Changed WEAPON script to detect if controller used and change user prompts
[/list]
[h1]Multiplayer[/h1]
[list]
[*] You can now select a custom head Character Creator character as your avatar in multiplayer games
[*] Fixed a crash that could occur when hosting a multiplayer game
[*] Fixed an issue in multiplayer where a Character Creator characters head would wobble if shot
[*] Low FPS Warning can no longer interfere with MP games (showing mouse ptr)
[*] Moved fonts image offset higher than grass texture to fix MP nameplate issue
[*] When choosing your online avatar in multiplayer the name and thumbnails are shown
[/list]
[h1]Character Creator[/h1]
[list]
[*] A new selection of male and female heads and head attachments have been added to Character Creator
[img]http://content.game-guru.com/news/v1003/moreheads.jpg[/img]
[*] You can now create your own custom character faces for both male and female by choosing and adjusting an image
[*] Fixed an issue with Character Creator characters not registering a headshot
[*] Custom character heads can color match the skin tone of your imported image with the original texture on the character
[*] New hair and hats have been added to Character Creator
[*] You can now color hair and hats in Character Creator
[*] Fixed an issue where Character Creator characters would not show their head from certain distances
[*] Tidied up Character Creator text and panels
[*] You can now use save standalone and multiplayer with character creator characters with custom heads
[*] Female Character Creator characters now have female voices!
[*] Skin tone in Character Creator is now more subtle and no longer washes away the texture detailing
[*] When saving a Character Creator character, the produced thumbnail is a much closer head and shoulders shot
[*] Heads are now detected when custom character shot and removed after ragdoll
[/list]
[h1]Misc[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added support for XBOX Controller (although we disabled it for now - needs more testing time);
[*] Added 'g_PlayerController' to LUA globals, knows when XBOX controller flagged
[*] Disabled XBOX Controller flag while we test against more controllers
[*] To solve ancient BIN file issue, all entities reset the BIN each time they load
[*] Removed the TransparentFace message error when lightmapping some store content
[*] Fixed code which detects for Entity BIN versions - no more corrupt animations
[/list]

notes.title: V1.003 Release Week!
notes.content:
[img]http://content.game-guru.com/news/gglogo.jpg[/img]
Welcome to the GameGuru weekly news. We are now very close to the release of the latest update and you can read all about our progress below.

As always you can read what's new in the GameGuru Store and we'll take a look at some of the great work from the user galleries.

[img]http://content.game-guru.com/news/2015/290615/ggnews1.jpg[/img]

We also spotted this [url=https://forum.game-guru.com/thread/210885]WIP thread[/url] from developer Nuncio which has really impressed us with the quality of work and amazing progress made. It's great to see some of the games being developed and we will be watching this one carefully.

So, let's take a look at what's been happening in the world of GameGuru...

[h1]From the Galleries[/h1]
We are always keeping an eye of the galleries and are constantly inspired by the amazing work our community produces. We felt that these recent uploads really stood out and show a real change of genre from the modern day themes we often see.

[img]http://content.game-guru.com/news/2015/290615/ggnews2.jpg[/img]
[i]Palm Cove by Shadowman[/i]

[img]http://content.game-guru.com/news/2015/290615/ggnews3.jpg[/img]
[i]The Lake by thecrippledgamer[/i]

[h1]Store News[/h1]
As the store goes from strength to strength, we're always pleased to see the diverse range of uploads from our very talented artists. We're taking a look at a new upload this week as well as a reminder of a high quality model pack. Recent uploads bring the current total to 4,928 items available on the [url=http://en.tgcstore.net/]GameGuru Store[/url] for sale or for free, so we'll soon be pushing past the 5,000 mark!

[img]http://content.game-guru.com/news/2015/290615/ggnews4.jpg[/img]

This great [url=http://en.tgcstore.net/?md=view-pack&pid=10615]Crane Pack[/url] by artist [url=http://en.tgcstore.net/?md=artist-view&aid=186502]Nomis3D[/url] features 8 crane variations and will help bring any modern day or construction level to life.
 
We're also looking back at the excellent [url=http://en.tgcstore.net/?md=view&oid=20859]Arcade Pack[/url] from artist [url=http://en.tgcstore.net/?md=artist-view&aid=77474]ErrantAI.[/url]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=G4nfHTKGfCo
This pack includes a large number of 1980's themed retro arcade cabinets and is a worthy addition to any serious developers library.

[h1]Become a Store Artist![/h1]
The Game Creator Store connects creative artists and musicians with enthusiastic GameGuru game developers. Can you create game ready 3D models or themed atmospheric music for the GameGuru community? If so, sign into the GameGuru website and [url=http://en.tgcstore.net/?md=sell-content]Sign Up to HERE![/url]

[h1]Latest GameGuru Development News[/h1]
Last week we continued our work on stability and we've tweaked and improved a number of additional features. Here's a list of the key items we worked on last week:
[list]
[*] You can now select a custom head Character Creator character as your avatar in multiplayer games!
[*] Replaced CHECKING FOR FILES with full status progress text (To assist users in debugging)
[*] Moved version number display to start of splash sequence (saved 1.5 seconds!)
[*] Changed WEAPON script to detect if controller used and change user prompts
[*] Fixed issue with POST PROCESS shader using fixed DOF render size (now adapts)
[*] If character has no .DAT file associated (UBER), no longer rotates the waste
[*] Adjusted non DAT characters (above) to accurately line up gun direction
[*] Low FPS Warning can no longer interfere with MP games (showing mouse ptr)
[/list]

[h1]Signing off[/h1]
We are now very close to our next release and are in the final rounds of testing. All being well users should see a new version in the next few days.

After the release of this V1.003 we will turn our focus to performance work. We have a clear strategy on how to optimise the engine and are confident that this work will open to way for a lot of new and exciting feature additions in the months to come.

So, until next week, good luck with your developments and as always, thank you all for your amazing support.

[i]The GameGuru Team[/i]

notes.title: Friday Devblog - Version 1.01.003
notes.content:
As we put the finishing touches to the next update, I am also recovering from what was one of the best evenings of my geeky life as I attended "Back In Time Brighton" and indulged in a trip back in time to my C64 days and the sound of those amazing SID tracks we almost learned by heart (for those of you that still remember coding 8-bit).

Back in Game Guru land, aside from the usual tweaks and fixes we have been working on getting more media into the core product and packs.  Here are some additions to the Death Valley DLC which will grace Steam very soon:

[img]http://content.game-guru.com/devblog/build101003-MoreDeathValleyAssets.png[/img]

We have also commissioned two more wizard characters for the core product, which you will get for free in the next update, allowing you to choose whether to play an evil wizard or a regal one:

[img]http://content.game-guru.com/devblog/build101003-evilwizardpose.png[/img]

We've also been expanding the number of bodies you can choose in the Character Creator module, which you will get for free during a forthcoming update too.  Instead of creating one-off characters for you, we decided to cut them up and add them as 'parts' to the Character Creator allowing you to create any combination you want and come up with your own variant of the new characters that will be produced and added to the Game Guru universe:

[img]http://content.game-guru.com/devblog/build101003-3.jpg[/img]

In addition to bodies, we are also generating new heads for you as well. Thin ones, fat ones, and otherwise shapes which should give you a decent selection to chose form. We started with the male heads, but will provide some female heads as well so you can create the perfect custom character for your game:

[img]http://content.game-guru.com/devblog/build101003-faces.png[/img]

As you can see below, our internal team have been having lots of fun creating a variety of new faces for our multiplayer avatars, which by the way is another cool feature for the next update and literally allows you to craft your own self and star in any multiplayer game you join, even appearing in other peoples multiplayer games as yourself!

[img]http://content.game-guru.com/devblog/build101003-GreenNightmare.png[/img]

The faces above and below are the insane creations of our part time project manager, part time loony, Ricky Baby who has a knack for creating extremely disturbing characters that fit appropriately with his predilection for violence when in the arena.

[img]http://content.game-guru.com/devblog/build101003-gross.png[/img]

Today we had a final death-match and co-op test to check out the new face transfer system (no Steam workshop required, it does it on the fly), and someone captured a shot of my latest creation, which is not taken from a horror movie but is in fact my actual face.  It reminded me to take more time in crafting my facial proportions in future!

[img]http://content.game-guru.com/devblog/build101003-LeeandLana.png[/img]

I cannot really describe how rewarding it is to work on games and game creation technology, but it's one of those rare jobs that brings something new to experience almost every day.  Imagine peeling potatoes for over 30 years, and wander how much surprise you can squeeze out of such a career after 3 decades. Well I've been doing this longer, and I am still thrilled to be involved in what I consider the best job in history. If you are just starting out in the game creation field, and enjoy the process of creating, tweaking and showing what you've made to fiends, family and the wider world, consider that this is just the very beginning of your adventure, and if you chose you can make it your life long pursuit.  Having made the journey myself, and know many colleagues who've made similar voyages, I can assure you it is well worth it and if sometimes you feel it's getting a little tough, just take a break, play some more games and try again the following day. It's not a race, it's a hobby that one day, might just open a door that allows you to do your most favorite thing every day, and get paid for doing it!  My hope is that Game Guru could help you start this journey, offering just enough depth with LUA scripting and fine grain controls to take you to the next level with confidence and a few cool games under your belt.  Watch out for the new updates to the core product and DLCs early in July, and of course keep checking the Game Guru Store which hosts new items every day!

notes.title: GameGuru V1.01.003 approaches…
notes.content:
[img]http://content.game-guru.com/news/gglogo.jpg[/img]
Welcome to the GameGuru weekly news, we hope that you’re all enjoying the latest update (and of course, looking forward to the next.).

This last week has mainly been about tweaks and fixes to the engine, and you can read all about the work to date below. We also touch a little on our plans for the future as we aim to keep improving GameGuru so you’re games can be top quality.

[img]http://content.game-guru.com/news/2015/220615/ggnews1.jpg[/img]
[i]The Village by Steam user Gazz[/i]

So, let’s see what we've been up to since the last news bulletin.

[h1]Store News[/h1]
As always, the store has seen an amazing number of quality uploads, making it harder to know what to showcase! We’re approaching another milestone in the life of GameGuru with nearly 5,000 items available, either for free or for a great price.

Let’s take a look at some of the latest releases.

[img]http://content.game-guru.com/news/2015/220615/ggnews2.jpg[/img]

Store artist [url=http://en.tgcstore.net/?md=artist-view&aid=124126]BSP[/url] has added to his range of excellent weapons with this amazing [url=http://en.tgcstore.net/?md=view-pack&pid=10612]sci-fi weapons pack.[/url] Featuring 5 brand new weapons for all of your futuristic needs.

[img]http://content.game-guru.com/news/2015/220615/ggnews3.jpg[/img]

Another talented store artist [url=http://en.tgcstore.net/?md=artist-view&aid=220382]Noktavian[/url] has uploaded his second [url=http://en.tgcstore.net/?md=view-pack&pid=10611]skybox pack.[/url] The great value pack is not only exceptional quality, but adds six new skyboxes to your collect spanning several genres.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?t=10&v=gjDsB2Cky48
These fun and atmospheric rabbit critters from [url=http://en.tgcstore.net/?md=artist-view&aid=123361]Dagored[/url] are ideal for almost any genre, and add a real sense of life to your games.

[h1]DLC News[/h1]
If you were a purchaser of our Death Valley DLC pack (and if not, we suggest you [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/365540/]check it out here[/url]), you’ll be pleased to know that as promised, we’ve been working our artist hard for a great new update to the pack. All purchasers of the original Death Valley will be able to download the new assets for free very soon.

[img]http://content.game-guru.com/news/2015/220615/ggnews4.jpg[/img]
[i]Death Valley update teaser[/i]

[h1]Become a Store Artist![/h1]
The Game Creator Store connects creative artists and musicians with enthusiastic GameGuru game developers. Can you create game ready 3D models or themed atmospheric music for the GameGuru community? If so, sign into the GameGuru website and [url=http://en.tgcstore.net/?md=sell-content]sign up to HERE![/url]

[h1]GameGuru Development update news[/h1]
It’s been another exciting week internally, we've been planning how to move forward and improve GameGuru so you can create awesome games in the easiest way possible!

We're planning one more release (Version 1.01.003) at the end of this month and then the entire coding team will be focusing their efforts on improving the engine’s performance. We had highlighted a number of optimisations which we know you'll love. Of course it’s early days yet, and we expect performance work to take several weeks for the first round of improvements, but we feel this is the number one pressing issue for a lot of our users and we're determined to impress you with future results of this work.

What can you expect for the next immediate release? Well, we've been targeting a few of the smaller issues that have been highlighted to us since the last build, and rather than adding too many new features we felt that the community would have us focus on stability before moving forward. One of the main improvements is the new Face Changer feature for the Character Creator! You can now easily import a face image and map it onto any of the character heads. You can then save the new character and it can be an enemy character or you can use it in Multiplayer. We’ve had a lot of fun with this feature and enjoyed using famous faces during testing!

[img]http://content.game-guru.com/news/2015/220615/ggnews5.jpg[/img]

Adding a face is very easy. Select a photo of a face, match the face to the stencil of the face shape, eyes, nose and mouth by using the round icons. The skin colour can be matched by sampling three key points from the original image.

[img]http://content.game-guru.com/news/2015/220615/ggnews6.jpg[/img]

Once imported you can then choose the clothing and head gear for the character.

We're sure you'll enjoy this new feature and look forward to seeing you in a Multiplayer game soon! :-)

Other fixes in the upcoming build include;
[list]
[*] Fixed all marker entities so they no longer Z clash with terrain & floors
[*] Removed redundant , and . keys in test game mode as visual adjusted with sliders now
[*] Fixed code which detects for Entity BIN versions – no more corrupt animations
[*] Now allows entities as static, even if animates (except character_basic.fx)
[*] Added new WIZARD EVIL and WIZARD ROYAL to the character assets
[*] Increased speed of APPLY CHANGES in Entity Properties (activemouse detection)
[*] If no water exposed in terrain, test game will skip water mask generation
[*] Fixed issue which ignored ROT values when spraying entities with ‘I’ key
[*] Re-activated code which XZ rotates entities slightly in spray mode
[*] F1 Help Page now stays on screen when F1 key held down
[*] Changed CLIP mode (TAB then CTRL+MouseWheel) to be independent of zoom
[*] Fixed issue of shotgun loading two shells when only one remained
[*] Added new STAFF icon and ammo icon (and new HUD mode of 11 to gunspec)
[*] Ensured all Fantasy Creatures do not ‘repeat-hit’ and only hit once
[*] Ensured Fantasy Creatures can hurt at double range to make combat tougher
[*] Moved hardwareflags reset to game init routine, terrain visibility reset
[*] Created shader instance for TPV characters for zero-depth rendering
[*] Created shader instance for TPV entity for zero-depth rendering
[*] Removed clipping cap and ensured Y position value is accurate
[*] Added new RECENT folder to PURCHASED folder to list all store items
[*] We are also working on a new update to the main store website, we’re hoping to roll this out in early July.
[/list]
[h1]Signing off[/h1]
As stated, we've been busy on stability this last week and we will continue down that road until we and our internal testing team are happy. We will be bringing you the new build at the end of the month, so it’s back into the coding bunker for another round of fixes and tweaks.

Don’t forget [url=https://www.game-guru.com/devblog/]Lee’s Blog[/url] for daily updates on development and the occasional surprise.

See you all soon.

The GameGuru team

[img]http://content.game-guru.com/news/2015/220615/ggnews6.jpg[/img]

Once imported you can then choose the clothing and head gear for the character.

We're sure you'll enjoy this new feature and look forward to seeing you in a Multiplayer game soon! :-)

Other fixes in the upcoming build include;
[list]
[*] Fixed all marker entities so they no longer Z clash with terrain & floors
[*] Removed redundant , and . keys in test game mode as visual adjusted with sliders now
[*] Fixed code which detects for Entity BIN versions – no more corrupt animations
[*] Now allows entities as static, even if animates (except character_basic.fx)
[*] Added new WIZARD EVIL and WIZARD ROYAL to the character assets
[*] Increased speed of APPLY CHANGES in Entity Properties (activemouse detection)
[*] If no water exposed in terrain, test game will skip water mask generation
[*] Fixed issue which ignored ROT values when spraying entities with ‘I’ key
[*] Re-activated code which XZ rotates entities slightly in spray mode
[*] F1 Help Page now stays on screen when F1 key held down
[*] Changed CLIP mode (TAB then CTRL+MouseWheel) to be independent of zoom
[*] Fixed issue of shotgun loading two shells when only one remained
[*] Added new STAFF icon and ammo icon (and new HUD mode of 11 to gunspec)
[*] Ensured all Fantasy Creatures do not ‘repeat-hit’ and only hit once
[*] Ensured Fantasy Creatures can hurt at double range to make combat tougher
[*] Moved hardwareflags reset to game init routine, terrain visibility reset
[*] Created shader instance for TPV characters for zero-depth rendering
[*] Created shader instance for TPV entity for zero-depth rendering
[*] Removed clipping cap and ensured Y position value is accurate
[*] Added new RECENT folder to PURCHASED folder to list all store items
[*] We are also working on a new update to the main store website, we’re hoping to roll this out in early July.
[/list]
[h1]Signing off[/h1]
As stated, we've been busy on stability this last week and we will continue down that road until we and our internal testing team are happy. We will be bringing you the new build at the end of the month, so it’s back into the coding bunker for another round of fixes and tweaks.

Don’t forget [url=https://www.game-guru.com/devblog/]Lee’s Blog[/url] for daily updates on development and the occasional surprise.

See you all soon.

The GameGuru team

notes.title: Friday Devblog - Version 1.01.002
notes.content:
This week we released the much awaited 002 version, an update that was three weeks in the making and introduces motion blur and DOF effects for the first time in Game Guru.  The release went well and our next mission is to take reports for any minor issues that might have sprung up which we could not catch at the testing stage.

[img]http://content.game-guru.com/devblog/build101002c-bunnyfirefine.jpg[/img]

During our extensive testing, a number of shots where produced which highlight the versatility of the product, and in the one above it shows just how colorful you can make your games.

[img]http://content.game-guru.com/devblog/build101002c-OrangeScene.png[/img]

If your favorite color is orange, there is a color scheme for you too, as demonstrated with this rather exaggerated rocky scene.  Also in this shot you might make out the depth of field effect at work as the more distant geometry is blurred out of focus by the post process shader.

Many more improvements have been made for build 002, including lots of work on the third person control system and in a neighboring camp, work on multiplayer which now allows custom characters to be chosen as avatars so you can play yourself when running around a death match or co-op game.  As the Character Creator allows a lot of crazy combinations, it provides our testing team with a lot of fun seeing what hideous creations we're wearing next!  Work is now proceeding to allow your own face to be mapped to the custom characters to further the goal of making a personal avatar you can use for all multiplayer games.  Exciting stuff!

We have a team meeting next week to decide the next major update, and the community has so far indicated that performance should be the sole target of our efforts, and I am inclined to agree.  We have a few levels that run under 30 fps and a few more than run under 60 fps. It would be ideal if we can get ALL our stock levels well past the basic 60 frames per second threshold, and then continue this work to ensure even large levels never drop below this minimum setting (PC systems permitting).  We are currently setting quite a low minimum spec for Game Guru, and with this performance work we have the possibility of reducing the requirements still further.

My thanks to the community so far who have posted reviews on the Steam Community Hub, and an extra thanks for those who posted glowing scores! It's early days and it's great we have your confidence moving forward as we aim to build the easiest game maker on the planet. For now, have a great weekend and I look forward to bringing you more news on what is happening in the engine room of Game Guru next week.

notes.title: V1.01.002 Released!
notes.content:
Today we're releasing V1.01.002, a big update that brings you new visual controls, improved third person camera controls, the ability to use your avatars from the character creator in multiplayer and many other tweaks, fixes and improvements. Here are the main highlights;

[h1]Third Person[/h1]
[list]
[*] Extra camera properties for this gameplay mode
[*] Improve camera collision
[*] Added dynamic light effect to any projectile fired by player
[*] Added 'Camera Locked' property to third person camera for isometrics
[*] Restored system of auto-targeting if in camera locked mode
[*] Camera Offset values allow you to shift the camera for over-shoulder views
[*] New Run Mode option!
[*] 'Show Reticle' controls visibility of the third person crosshair
[/list]

[h1]Editor[/h1]
[list]
[*] You can now use mouse wheel to zoom in and out of free flight mode
[*] No more water clipping when viewing editor terrain from a distance
[*] When in entity SPRAY MODE (press I), no longer need to hold SHIFT
[*] New feature; hold down Ctrl+MouseWheel in free flight to adjust Y-camera clipping NOTE: You can use camera clip by pressing TAB in the IDE editor
[*] Supports middle button mouse press for camera drag and pan control
[*] Entities on 'auto find floor' no longer sink below terrain
[*] Can now put entities on top of other entities of any size
[*] Marker (player start) entities no longer cast shadows for cleaner visual
[/list]

[h1]Widget[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added keys 1 through 6 for widget rotation control of entity
[*] Changed TOOLTIP Test Level to Test Game (aligns with tutorials)
[*] Widget alignment fix when 'looking up from horizon'
[/list]

[h1]Weapons[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added dynamic light effect to exploding fireball
[*] Added SPOT LIGHTING to weapon properties or dynamic spot light effect
[*] Added dofdistance and dofintensity fields in GUNSPEC for DOF override
[*] Added smoothing so when enter scope mode, DOF effect fades out slower
[/list]

[h1]Graphics[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added Vignette to post process shader for more modern game look
[*] Added general motion blur to post process shader on HIGHEST
[*] Extended MOTION BLUR to all shader levels as it smooths at low FPS
[*] Added Depth-Of-Field effect to post process shader (far distance only). NOTE: For MOTION+DOF you need Bloom Level to be a value of one or more
[*] Added slider panel for POST EFFECTS control (bloom, motion blur, dof)
[*] New support in LIGHTRAY shader for sun color and strength (skyspec.txt)
[/list]

[h1]LUA Scripting[/h1]
[*] Added six new LUA commands to control new POST EFFECTS in scripts;
[*] SetPostVignetteRadius(v) where v controls the size of the vignette effect
[*] SetPostVignetteIntensity(v) where v controls the strength of the vignette
[*] SetPostMotionDistance(v) where v controls distance at which blur starts
[*] SetPostMotionIntensity(v) where v controls the intensity of motion blur
[*] SetPostDepthOfFieldDistance(v) where v controls distance DOF starts
[*] SetPostDepthOfFieldIntensity(v) where v controls the strength of DOF
[*] Added zoomhidecrosshair to GUNSPEC to hide crosshair when zoomed (sniper)
[/list]

[h1]Performance[/h1]
[list]
[*] Changed way the weapon ray iterations work for increased performance
[/list]

[h1]Media[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added new SKYBANK choice called FOREST, special thanks to MR LOGAN!
[*] Updated Fantasy Level with new FOREST sky and balanced DOF settings
[/list]

[h1]Characters[/h1]
[list]
[*] Character physics capsules are now created proportional to their size
[*] Improved 'rate of fire' to produce a less 'timed repeat' feel to it
[*] Fixed Medieval and Zombie characters so they are not floating
[*] Discontinued use of OFFY in FPE settings and fixed capsule physics
[/list]

[h1]Multiplayer[/h1]
[list]
[*] Character Creator characters can now be used as your avatar in multiplayer sessions
[*] Chat messages that exceed maximum length are now truncated properly rather than losing the last few characters
[*] You can no longer pick up weapons and ammo when the final score screen is being displayed
[/list]

[h1]Misc[/h1]
[list]
[*] When saving standalone game that includes Cartoon Gun, works fine now
Many other fixes and tweaks!
[/list]

Please let us know your feedback on this version.

[img]http://content.game-guru.com/news/2015/090615/ggnews1.jpg[/img]

You can see some of the new visual effects at work in this shot taken from a game being developed by a member of the support team.

You can read a summary of what you will find in the next release at the end of this bulletin, but for now, let's see what's going on in the GameGuru store.

[h1]Store News[/h1]

The store continues to grow, having passed 4,670 assets available to help budding developers in their quest for new and exciting media for their masterpieces.

[img]http://content.game-guru.com/news/2015/090615/ggnews02.jpg[/img]

This great new [url=http://en.tgcstore.net/?md=view-pack&pid=10598]mill pack[/url] from [url=http://en.tgcstore.net/?md=artist-view&aid=155097]Lafette[/url] features a selection of medieval houses, props and mills, ideally suited for period or fantasy games.

[img]http://content.game-guru.com/news/2015/090615/ggnews03.jpg[/img]

[url=http://en.tgcstore.net/?md=view-pack&pid=10336]Shipping Containers[/url] by [url=http://en.tgcstore.net/?md=artist-view&aid=186502]Nomis3d[/url] have been on the store for a little while now, but are always worth a review. Great for almost any modern game set from 1940's upwards

https://youtu.be/umho-OTDOJI

[url=http://en.tgcstore.net/?md=artist-view&aid=123361]Dagored[/url] has added once more to his collection of critters with these excellent [url=http://en.tgcstore.net/?md=view&oid=23355]Rats[/url]. Do you have a game they could star in? :-)

[img]http://content.game-guru.com/news/2015/090615/ggnews04.jpg[/img]
These lovely looking plants from [url=http://en.tgcstore.net/?md=artist-view&aid=115778]Automatic[/url] are animated and very reasonably priced. There are three variations, [url=http://en.tgcstore.net/?md=view&oid=23145]Fantasy Elements Plant 1[/url] , [url=http://en.tgcstore.net/?md=view&oid=23417]Fantasy Elements Plant 2[/url], [url=http://en.tgcstore.net/?md=view&oid=23418]Fantasy Elements Plant 3[/url]

[h1]Become a Store Artist![/h1]

The Game Creator Store connects creative artists and musicians with enthusiastic GameGuru game developers. Can you create game ready 3D models or themed atmospheric music for the GameGuru community? If so, sign into the GameGuru website and [url=http://en.tgcstore.net/?md=sell-content]sign up to HERE![/url]

[h1]Competition News[/h1]

With still 3 days to go, the GameGuru screenshot competition is looking very hot indeed. This has seen many, many entries, far more than any other competition to date and we are sure that choosing the final winners will be a difficult task. We've chosen a couple at random just to showcase the quality of many of the entries.

[img]http://content.game-guru.com/news/2015/090615/ggnews05.jpg[/img]
This scene inspired by Mad Max is from [i]Slaur3n[/i].

[img]http://content.game-guru.com/news/2015/090615/ggnews06.jpg[/img]
The very psychedelic scene is from user [i]0Alermar0[/i]

[h1]A forward look at GameGuru 1.00.002[/h1]

We expect V1.00.002 of GameGuru to be released this week. We are just running some final tests now. There has been some pretty major additions for this build which will change the way many games look and feel, including a whole host of new fullscreen shader effects:
[list]
[*] Motion Blur
[*] Depth of Field
[*] Vignette
[/list]
We've also spent time improving 3rd Person view and adding some much requested camera control:

[list]
[*] Extra camera properties for this gameplay mode
[*] Improve camera collision
[*] Added dynamic light effect to any projectile fired by player
[*] Added 'Camera Locked' property to third person camera for isometrics
[*] Restored system of auto-targeting if in camera locked mode
[*] Camera X & Y values allows you to shift the camera for different over the shoulder views
[*] Run Mode will not force camera behind protagonist during game
[*] 'Show Reticle' will control visibility of the third person crosshair
[/list]
We have also set aside some time for multiplayer work.
[list]
[*] Character Creator characters can now be used as your avatar in multiplayer sessions!
[*] Chat messages that exceed maximum length are now truncated properly rather than losing the last few characters
[*] You can no longer pick up weapons and ammo when the final score screen is being displayed
[/list]
These of course are just a few of the fixes and additions, and we expect more to be added before we release later this week. You can find a full list then in the GameGuru change log.

[h1]Signing Off[/h1]

Back to the  work once again – We expect the next release very soon!

Don't forget [url=https://www.game-guru.com/devblog/]Lee’s Blog[/url] for daily updates and of course a few surprises.

The GameGuru team
